consulted_source.title: Occasioned by the death of Creveliers off Astypalaia: The island’s role in the raids by Catholic corsairs during the 17th century
consulted_source.creator: Giorgos Koutzakiotis

passages.exact_acquired_quote:
At the same time, Astypalaia was an excellent hideout for corsairs, not only because they could ﬁnd provisions there (such as bread, wine, etc.) and stock up with drinking water, but also because the island provided
plenty of safe anchorages.
passages.source_attributed_reading: The author describes Astypalaia as a corsair hideout with provisions, drinking water and safe anchorages. This is an attribution to the modern study.

passages.exact_acquired_quote:
we
examine the role of the bay of Vathy in the corsair raids, since this is most likely where the explosion

passages.source_attributed_reading: The author proposes Vathy bay as the most likely location of the ship explosion. Most likely must not become a verified location.
